reason: The README clearly describes a Windows Electron desktop wrapper that launches and presents the DeepSeek Harness web interface while sharing its local DSH data directory.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面封装为 Windows Electron 桌面应用，并管理本地 DSH 服务与共享数据目录。
summaries.en: A Windows Electron desktop wrapper for the DeepSeek Harness web interface that manages the local DSH service and shared data directory.

capabilities: Wraps the DeepSeek Harness web interface in an Electron desktop window
Starts and manages a local DSH service process
Reads and writes shared DSH configuration, plugin, session, credential, and storage data
Bundles and selects a Node.js runtime for launching DSH
